articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Crane NXT, Co. (NYSE: CXT) ("Crane NXT" or the "Company"), a global leader in authentication and traceability technologies, today announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Sales of $497 million, up 12% year-over-year; organic sales growth of 1%. GAAP earnings per diluted share (EPS) of $0.66, and Adjusted EPS of $1.28. Cash from operations of $112 million; Adjusted free cash flow conversion of 132%. Raised the midpoint of full-year adjusted EPS guidance and narrowed the range, while updating our full-year sales outlook. Aaron W. Saak, Crane NXT's President and Chief Executive Officer, stated: "We continued to make progress against our strategic priorities in the third quarter. articles.title: Crane NXT Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
